findings.title: URL aliases bypass canonical-accession duplicate checks
findings.cause: citation accepted identifiers recognized by normalize_reference, including URLs, while add_citations compared raw reference accession strings for duplicates.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic UniProtKB:P00001 was already present as a CURIE; a plan using its UniProt entry URL appended a duplicate. A mixed CURIE/URL pair within one plan was also accepted.
findings.impact: A malformed future plan could append duplicate evidence and inflate citation counts. This does not establish additional independent evidence.
findings.current_curation_reason: The saved plan uses canonical CURIEs. All three existing citation transitions still reproduce byte-exactly.
findings.fix: Require UniProtKB and NCBITaxon reference metadata values to equal their canonical parsed identifiers. Evidence URLs remain supported in the existing citation index; only plan metadata is narrowed.

verification.public_checkpoint_reconstruction: PASS in temporary directories containing only the public receipt and corresponding record
verification.limitation: Focused regression verification only. The earlier 12-gate full-QC result applies to the pre-review code and remains an immutable historical receipt. Its RDKit environment limitation remains documented there.
